title: RECOVER: Robust Entity Correction via agentic Orchestration of hypothesis Variants for Evidence-based Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2603.16411v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Entity recognition in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) is challenging for rare and domain-specific terms. In domains such as finance, medicine, and air-traffic control, these errors are costly. If an entity is entirely absent from the ASR output, text-only post-correction has little signal to recover it. To address this, we introduce RECOVER, an agentic post-ASR entity-correction framework. It leverages multiple hypotheses as evidence from ASR, retrieves relevant entities, proposes Large Language Model (LLM) correction under constraints, filters them through deterministic guardrails and uses an LLM critic that judges each surviving edit and can trigger a targeted feedback round to recover an entity the first pass missed. The hypotheses are used by one of several strategies, namely 1-Best, Entity-Aware Select, Recognizer Output Voting Error Reduction (ROVER) Ensemble, LLM-Select and Adaptive Routing. translated_title: RECOVER：通过假设变体的智能体式编排实现基于证据恢复的鲁棒实体校正
translated_abstract: 在自动语音识别（ASR）中，对稀有和领域特定术语的实体识别极具挑战性。在金融、医疗和空中交通管制等领域，这些错误会造成高昂代价。如果某个实体在ASR输出中完全缺失，仅基于文本的后处理校正几乎没有信号来恢复它。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RECOVER，一个智能体式后ASR实体校正框架。它将多个假设作为来自ASR的证据，检索相关实体，在约束条件下提出大语言模型（LLM）校正建议，通过确定性防护栏对其进行过滤，并使用一个LLM评论家来判断每个存活的编辑，还能触发有针对性的反馈轮次，以恢复第一轮处理中遗漏的实体。这些假设通过以下几种策略之一加以利用：1-Best、实体感知选择（Entity-Aware Select）、识别器输出投票错误降低（ROVER）集成、LLM-Select以及自适应路由。该方法在五个多样的数据（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RECOVER是一个智能体式后ASR实体校正框架，它将多个ASR假设作为证据，通过实体检索、约束条件下的LLM校正、确定性防护栏过滤以及可触发反馈轮次的LLM评论家，有效恢复稀有和领域特定实体。
en_tdlr: RECOVER is an agentic post-ASR entity-correction framework that uses multiple ASR hypotheses as evidence, combining entity retrieval, constrained LLM corrections, deterministic guardrails, and an LLM critic capable of triggering feedback rounds to recover rare and domain-specific entities.
